thread:
Aisha (CSM): quick sync — Fircliff week0 dry-run just completed. overall performance looks good but we have three small follow-ups: firewall egress CIDR narrower than requested, KMS key policy missing the Redwood infra role, and audit log prefixes inconsistent to their SIEM ingestion. low severity individually but collectively blocking final cutover.

Tom (Solutions): noted. their net team applied 52.11.0.0/24; we asked for 52.11.0.0/22. i pinged them to widen or add the extra ranges.

Rico (Eng-Infra): here's our recommended security-group egress rule to apply (they're on AWS):
```
Type: All TCP
Protocol: TCP
Port range: 0-65535
Destination: 52.11.0.0/22
Description: Redwood egress (api.redwood.internal)
```
If they only keep the /24 some API calls will fail under burst traffic.

Julia (Fircliff): thanks — i'll ask infra to apply /22 now and confirm. they rolled /24 late yesterday.

Sam (SRE): audit logs: TLS to their SIEM is OK but our router emits two different prefixes — `customer-prod-logs` and `customer-internal`. their parsing rules only pick up `customer-prod-logs`. we should normalize to one prefix for the cutover.

Aisha (CSM): Julia, can you have an engineer re-run smoke after the SG change? also, client requests KMS rotation Friday but our standard maintenance window is Saturday night — possible conflict.

Julia (Fircliff): client policy mandates Friday rotating keys. can you share the minimal KMS policy snippet to grant Redwood the necessary permissions?

Rico (Eng-Infra): minimal policy addition to allow our infra role access (paste this into their key policy):
```json
{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infra"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
That should let rotation proceed without escalating.

Julia (Fircliff): applying now, will confirm when saved.

Tom (Solutions): another item — audit log retention. regulatory requires 90 days, but our ingestion pipeline default was 30 days. we need to extend retention or stage an interim snapshot.

Aisha (CSM): flagged renewal risk: finance said they'll review commitments if cutover slips beyond two weeks (end of quarter budgeting). marking medium-term risk in account tracker. :warning:

Sam (SRE): opened ticket CI-4829 to change retention to 90d and added a 21-day snapshot hold to cover the interim.

deploy-bot: Dry-run artifacts uploaded: https://deploys.redwood.internal/reports/1747654322 — artifacts: network-checks.tar.gz, kms-policy-change.json, audit-preview.log

Aisha (CSM): consolidated action items — Rico: verify SG change and run smoke test; Tom: confirm retention change applied in pipeline; Sam: validate SIEM ingest after prefix normalization and close CI-4829; Julia: confirm KMS rotation schedule aligned to Friday and update finance note. update statuses by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:

Tom (Solutions): I'll confirm retention today.

Rico (Eng-Infra): will run smoke in ~90m after they push the /22.

Julia (Fircliff): rotation scheduled Fri 22:00 local. finance will hold off escalation for one week post-cutover. i'll notify when smoke completes.

Aisha (CSM): thanks everyone — i'll update the renewal radar and follow up with AMs after confirmations. closing the thread once all checks are green. :eyes:
